description: X12 EDI Parser — Offline ANSI X12 EDI parser and validator. Detects delimiters from the ISA header (element, component, repetition, segment terminator incl. CR/LF), walks ISA/IEA, GS/GE and ST/SE envelopes and checks control numbers and counts (SE01 segment count, GE01, IEA01), flags missing trailers and GS functional-ID mismatches, and returns business summaries: 850/875 purchase orders (PO number, lines, quantities, extended total, CTT check), 810/880 invoices (lines vs TDS total, SAC allowances/charges), 856 ASN (BSN, HL hierarchy, carrier, BOL, PO numbers), 855, 997/999 acknowledgments (accepted/rejected sets with AK3/AK4 errors), 835 remittance (payment, trace, claims charged/paid), 837 claims (professional/institutional/dental, totals, billing NPI), 834 enrollment, 270/271, 276/277, 820, 204, 214, 846, 990. Pass the interchange in text= (URL-encoded); segments=1 returns every parsed segment. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_x12
